messages:
olivia: Heads-up — pricing sync: need final decisions on package ceilings, surge protection, and priority add-ons before roadmap freeze on Friday. Sales pulled three customer asks that could shift scope: rollover burst credits, a paid "priority routing" addon, and mixed softcap/hardcap behavior.

matt: +1. We should lock launch criteria now. My take: keep packaging simple for GA, push complex billing (rollovers) to post-launch pilot.

lauren: From ops POV: hardcaps are easiest to enforce and reason about for autoscaling. Softcaps + rollovers adds billing/regression surface (and weird headroom).

sunil: On the infra side, softcaps can work if we pair with two levers: (1) short-term burst credits that are metered separately, (2) an automatic throttling fallback at 2x baseline. Example config snippet for discussion:
```
baseline_tokens_per_month: 50_000_000
burst_multiplier: 2.0   # allows short bursts up to 2x baseline
burst_window_minutes: 60
rollover_policy: none / pilot
```

david: Sales note: enterprise pilot customers are asking for rollover and guaranteed priority routing during spikes. They say priority routing commands higher price and helps justify committed spend. But they also ask for transferability of credits between teams — big billing complexity.

eng-product-bot: Reminder: feature flag `pricing_surges_v2` is enabled on staging and will expire in 7 days unless extended.

olivia: Proposal draft: - Keep Starter / Professional / Enterprise tiers. - Starter: hardcap 5M tokens/mo, no burst. - Professional: softcap 50M tokens/mo with 2x burst credits (no rollover at launch). - Enterprise: custom ceilings + optional paid "priority routing" addon. Rationale: reduces billing complexity at GA while covering common customer asks.

lauren: Operational caveats to capture in launch: include explicit SLOs for priority routing (e.g., P95 latency delta max), and a hard fallback policy if priority queues exceed N% of capacity. Also add monitoring dashboards for per-tenant burst consumption.

matt: Action items: @sunil size infra cost delta for priority routing and burst headroom by Wed EOD; @david draft customer-facing addon terms & non-rollover language; @lauren propose monitoring + fallback thresholds; I'll own final launch criteria doc and go/no-go checklist.

olivia: :thumbsup: If we get those inputs by Wed we can aim for a minor release after the freeze. Also need comms: product one-pager + FAQ that explains softcap vs hardcap and why rollover is delayed to pilot.

sunil: Ack — will run a quick perf/cost sim and share numbers (estimated GPU-hours + expected token cost delta).

david: I'll start a short legal/billing scoping thread for rollover complexity.

matt: Thanks team — sync on Wed 10am to review numbers.

olivia: Thanks all — tagging this ticket in the roadmap (RF-3124) and marking it for the pricing workstream.
